claims: Saudi Arabia has officially declared that Eid al-Fitr 2026 will fall on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The Shawwal crescent moon was not sighted on the evening of Wednesday, March 18, 2026.
Thursday, March 19 marks the final day of fasting for Ramadan.
The moon-sighting committee was unable to locate the crescent on Wednesday, March 18, 2026, marking the end of the month of Ramadan.
The first day of Eid al-Fitr 1447 AH is confirmed for Friday, March 20, 2026.
The UAE, Qatar, and Bahrain are among the Gulf countries following Saudi Arabia in observing Eid al-Fitr on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The Holy Mosques in Saudi Arabia confirmed the end of Ramadan following the completion of the 30-day fast, according to Manchester Evening News.
